question: Where and when were the first Khelo India University Games held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha, 2020.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first Khelo India University Games** were held in **Odisha in 2020.**
 
• The event was organized by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** and the **Government of Odisha**.
 
• The games were aimed at **promoting sports culture** and **excellence** among university students in India.
 
• Over** 3,000 athletes **from more than** 150 universities **participated in the event.
 
• The games included **17 disciplines**, including athletics, badminton, basketball, football, and swimming.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra** did host the** Khelo India Youth Games in 2019**, which is a separate event aimed at promoting sports among school students.

 
 
• On **January 20, 2019,** the Khelo India Youth Games came to an end in **Pune**.
 
• With 228 medals, **Maharashtra** led the field, followed by **Delhi and Haryana** in second and third place.
 
• With **85 gold medals,** Maharashtra won the **"General Championship of Khelo India 2019".**
 
 
 
• **Punjab** has **not **yet hosted any Khelo India games.
 
• **Kerala** hosted the Khelo India Youth Games in **2020**, but not the University Games.
 
 
• With** 78 gold, 77 silver, and 101 bronze medals,** **Maharashtra **successfully defended its title.
